summary: Iteration 16: tested payment types, payment breakdown in reports and the cash reconciliation, waste CRUD and stock math, staff my_today, public QR menu and cash-reminder cron auth. 10 of 11 backend tests pass. Found a CRITICAL crash and fixed it: the Stok Sayımı tab hit a runtime error because /api/dashboard did not return a `waste` key, so WasteLog called items.length on undefined. I added `waste` to the dashboard response. After the fix, all admin, staff (390px) and public /menu UI flows pass. Two open defects remain: (1) a failed waste PUT leaves the stock wrong; (2) the waste modal's Malzeme select shows the first item but does not send it, so saving without touching the select fails with 422.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the response had no `waste` list. The frontend setData(result) replaced the default empty waste:[], so the Stok Sayımı page crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' in <WasteLog>.

Not atomic. update_item first runs apply_waste(old,-1), which returns the stock, then apply_waste(doc,+1). If the new inventory_name matches no item, that second call raises 422 after the stock was already returned. The record is unchanged but stock is +qty too high (reproduced: 8.3 -> 9.3). Deleting the record later adds the qty back a second time. Fix: resolve and validate the new inventory before reversing the old one, or roll back on error.

minor.issue: find_one_and_delete runs before apply_waste. If the linked inventory item was deleted or renamed, apply_waste raises 422, but the waste record is already gone. The client sees an error even though the delete happened. Better: tolerate a missing inventory on reversal (skip the stock move) and return 200.
Items are keyed only by name. Duplicate product names inside one category would cause React key collisions in MenuPage (key={it.name}). Low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: The required select has no 'Seçin' option and the form state starts empty. The browser shows the first item (e.g. TEST_UI_Et), but if the user does not touch the select, the payload is {quantity:0.5} without inventory_name. The backend returns 422 and the user sees the generic toast 'Kayıt kaydedilemedi'. Fix: set required selects to their first option when the modal opens, or add a placeholder option and validate on the client. The same pattern affects other required selects (payment and reason fall back to defaults, so they are harmless today).

issues: 'Linki kopyala' showed the 'Kopyalanamadı' toast in headless Chromium because the clipboard permission is denied there. This is probably fine in real browsers, but consider an execCommand('copy') or select-text fallback.

action_items: Keep or confirm the tester fix: /api/dashboard now returns `waste` (server.py dashboard()). Also consider defaulting missing keys on the frontend (setData({...empty, ...result})).
Make PUT /api/waste/{id} atomic: validate the new inventory before reversing the old stock move.
Waste modal: pre-select the first inventory option, or add a placeholder with client-side validation, so the default selection is actually sent.
Optional: on waste delete, tolerate a missing inventory instead of returning 422 after the record is deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1040 lines; split it into modules (waste, reports, cron, staff).
update_item and delete_item in make_crud do side effects first and validate after (waste, sales). Any failure partway leaves stock out of sync. Validate first, then mutate.
Frontend setData(result) on the dashboard replaces the `empty` defaults. Any key the API leaves out crashes pages. Merge with the defaults.
The cron schedule (23:30 Istanbul) for /api/cron/cash-reminder could not be verified from the code; only the auth check (401) was tested.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass after the dashboard fix; waste-modal default-select bug open)

rca of the issue: Stok Sayımı crash: WasteLog receives data.waste. Dashboard.load() does setData(result) with the /api/dashboard payload, which had no 'waste' key, so items is undefined and items.length throws. This unmounts the whole dashboard. Mitigation: return waste from /api/dashboard (done) and merge with the defaults on the frontend. Waste PUT drift: reproduce by POST /api/waste qty 1, then PUT with inventory_name='nonexistent'. You get 422, but the stock rises by 1 because the reversal already ran.
